overview.description: The Grayscale Dogecoin Trust ETF Accred Inv (GDOG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long doge, short usd currency. The fund is passively managed, offering exposure to the daily USD spot price of Dogecoin (DOGE). An investment in the fund is not a direct investment in DOGE. GDOG was launched on Nov 24, 2025 and is issued by Grayscale.
